context.surface: A text cleanup tool and a reporting tool apply a policy for invisible characters.
assumptions: Use synthetic inputs in a local test harness.

review.invariant: Both tools apply the same documented character policy.
review.verification: Compare the detector and cleaner on synthetic text drawn from the policy classes. Include ordinary multilingual text as a preservation control.

source_observation.summary: The local review found inconsistent coverage. The repaired cleanup and detector passed the targeted policy regression.
